translations.EN: All right. We will make camp here.
translations.TL: Sige. Magkakampo tayo rito.

translations.EN: Setting up camp right in this spot.
translations.TL: Magtatayo ng kampo sa mismong pwestong ito.

translations.EN: Understood. Establishing camp.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Itatayo ang kampo.

translations.EN: Camp order received. Pitching shelter.
translations.TL: Natanggap ang utos magkampo. Maglalatag ng silong.

translations.EN: Good place to bed down. Making camp.
translations.TL: Magandang tulugan ito. Magkakampo.

translations.EN: Understood. Securing the campsite.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Seselyuhan ang kampo.

translations.EN: Right. Making camp here.
translations.TL: Sige. Magtatayo ng kampo rito.

translations.EN: On it. Setting up our camp.
translations.TL: Inaasikaso na. Itatayo ang kampo natin.

translations.EN: Camp routine initiated.
translations.TL: Sinisimulan na ang pagtatayo ng kampo.

translations.EN: Copy that. We camp here.
translations.TL: Kopyado. Dito tayo magkakampo.

translations.EN: I will settle in here for now.
translations.TL: Aayos muna ako ng pwesto rito sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Dropping my pack and settling down.
translations.TL: Ibababa ang bag at magpapahinga.

translations.EN: Settling in. Let me know if anything changes.
translations.TL: Nakaayos na. Sabihan ako kapag may nagbago.

translations.EN: Finding a comfortable corner right here.
translations.TL: Naghahanap ng komportableng sulok dito.

translations.EN: I'll rest my legs and settle in.
translations.TL: Ipapahinga ang mga binti at mananatili rito.

translations.EN: Settling into position. Feels decent.
translations.TL: Pumupwesto na. Mukhang maayos naman.

translations.EN: Unpacking light gear and settling here.
translations.TL: Maglalapag ng gamit at aayos ng higaan.

translations.EN: Settling in for the watch.
translations.TL: Nakaayos na para sa pagbabantay.

translations.EN: All right, I'll make myself at home here.
translations.TL: Sige, magpapahinga ako na parang nasa bahay.

translations.EN: Settling down. Staying alert.
translations.TL: Nagpapahinga na. Mananatiling alisto.

translations.EN: Understood. I will stay here and take care of my needs.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Mananatili ako rito at aasikasuhin ang mga pangangailangan ko.

translations.EN: I'll tend to my wounds and rest up here.
translations.TL: Gagamutin ko ang mga sugat at magpapahinga rito.

translations.EN: Taking care of hunger and thirst in camp.
translations.TL: Aasikasuhin ang gutom at uhaw sa kampo.

translations.EN: I'll patch up my gear and eat a meal here.
translations.TL: Aayusin ko ang gamit at kakain dito.

translations.EN: Good. I needed time to sort myself out.
translations.TL: Mabuti. Kailangan ko ng oras para ayusin ang sarili ko.

translations.EN: Handling my personal upkeep while we camp.
translations.TL: Aasikasuhin ang pansariling kalagayan habang nagkakampo.

translations.EN: Resting, eating, and recovering strength.
translations.TL: Nagpapahinga, kumakain, at nagpapalakas muli.

translations.EN: I'll use this camp time to recover.
translations.TL: Gagamitin ko ang oras sa kampo para magpagaling.

translations.EN: Taking care of myself while holding camp.
translations.TL: Aalagaan ang sarili habang nagbabantay sa kampo.

translations.EN: Understood. Time for self-maintenance.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Oras na para mag-ayos ng katawan.
